I believe the current Economic Boom period's remaining schedule is as follows:

5/16: Britain (London) - P.Metal/Alcohol/Wares
5/17: Dutch (Amsterdam) - Ore/Luxury/Crafts
5/18: Iberia - Spice/artwork/fragrances
5/19: Italy/S. France - Firearms/Medicine/Gems
5/20: Turkey (Istanbul) - Alcohol(!!!)/Textile/Arms
5/21: North France - Livestock/Seasoning/Fabric
5/22: Iberia - Sundries/Dyes/Seasoning
5/23: Britain (London) - P.Metal/Alcohol/Wares
5/24: Dutch - Ore/Luxury/Crafts
5/25: Iberia - Spice/Artwork/Fragrance

This is based on an economic boom schedule from October. If any errors emerge, please inform me and I will adjust the table as time permits. This message will be deleted at the conclusion of the event.

Cheers, and great Boombanning to you all.
